gaps.sentence: She's ___ charge of the whole marketing department.
___ first glance, the deal looks generous.
gaps.explanation: 'At first glance' = when first looked at quickly.

gaps.sentence: ___ the meantime, please finish the paperwork.
gaps.explanation: 'In the meantime' = during the time before something happens.

gaps.sentence: The evidence establishes guilt ___ reasonable doubt.
gaps.explanation: 'Beyond reasonable doubt' — the legal standard of proof.

gaps.sentence: The two reports differ ___ several important respects.
The venue was changed at ___ notice, just two days before.
gaps.explanation: 'At short notice' = only a short time before.

gaps.sentence: There's no point arguing ___ it now — the contract is signed.
I'll be there ___ ten minutes at the latest.
gaps.explanation: 'in ten minutes' = after ten minutes have passed.
